scope: Eight authored acceptance research tasks on two MDN educational examples from one new repository/publisher; four original-byte projects and four explicitly derived mutation projects as identified in provenance. Not customer websites, human usability, representative production accuracy or unseen model training data. No execution or backend observations.
referenceMethod: References fixed by independent source inspection before any provider response; preserve raw/application outcomes and full-answer review separately. Original source facts are historical content, not factual science validation. Mutations are authored counterexamples, never unmodified real sites.
